test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states topped the medals tally in the Northeast Olympic Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manipur** secured the top spot in the **Northeast Olympic Games** for the **second consecutive time**, clinching a **total of 237 medals**, with an impressive tally of 85 golds. 
 
• **Assam **closely followed in second place, accumulating 201 medals, including 81 golds. 
 
• The event, featuring athletes from eight states in the northeast region, took place on November 10. 
 
• This victory marks Manipur's continued dominance in the Games, building upon their previous success when they hosted the inaugural edition in October 2018 and topped the medal tally with 80 golds. 
 
• Renowned for producing Olympic medalists like boxer MC Mary Kom and weightlifter Mirabai Chanu, Manipur further solidified its position by securing an additional 17 medals, including seven golds, on the final day of competition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** secured the third position, while the host state Meghalaya claimed the fourth spot with a total of 149 medals (36 gold, 35 silver, 78 bronze). 
 
• This performance marked a significant improvement for Meghalaya compared to their sixth-place finish in the first edition, where they secured only 39 medals. 
 
• Meanwhile, as preparations for the** "Manipur Olympic Games 2022" **were underway, Manipur's Chief Minister Nongthombam Biren Singh unveiled the official mascot of the event, named Nongin after the state bird of Manipur, Mrs. Hume's pheasant. 
 
• Recognizing the importance of preserving this bird species and raising public awareness in Manipur, the Government of Manipur, led by Chief Minister Biren, officially adopted Nongin as the mascot for the sports event.
